{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|This is a diplomatic vessel of the Fifth Ruling Family, and we often welcome high-positioned officials aboard. Each social and professional position requires its own proper expanse, decor, and pattern. In each of those situations the reception area can be automatically reconfigured and decorated before the guest's arrival. As it is, the room is barely large enough to properly welcome a brother or sister of one of the Nine Families. Fortunately, most of them travel but little, and then mainly in vessels of their own.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Welcoming chambers''',<ref name="OF" /> also known as '''reception rooms''',<ref name="SQ" /> were rooms in which [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] held [[Welcoming ceremony|welcoming ceremonies]] for visiting [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and officials.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="OF date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> a welcoming chamber was located on the [[Crustai asteroid base]].<ref name="OF" /> In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="SQ date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> a grand reception room was located aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss diplomatic vessel]] ''[[Chaf Envoy]]''.<ref name="SQ" />
